finalText:
**The build passes now.** You were right, one warning was real.

Two spots broke from the bump, one after the other:

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The bundler now sends `retryCount`. It reads either one now.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset flag. The new config loader leaves it `undefined`. Unset now means off, like before.

The other 8 warnings are printed by `build.js` itself. The files they name do not exist here. So they are noise, and nothing in your code can silence them.
